moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-outexpo, written here): Target moves 0 → 100 % on cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), 400 ms (300–500 ms). Site rule: the standard entrance; when unsure, use this. GSAP expo.out is close; for the exact curve write custom(M0,0 C .16,1 .3,1 1,1). Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.4 s; 0.3–0.5) · prop (x) · ease (custom .16,1,.3,1).
